# Umbra

Umbra is a near-black interface built from hairline borders and muted grays, with headings distinguished by weight rather than colour. A single desaturated violet accent colours links, tags, the caret and subtle highlights, and Style Settings can replace it. Completed tasks fade, heavy chrome and shadows are stripped out, and popovers keep their depth.

![Umbra screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kebl3541/Obsidian-Umbra/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Umbra"
    author: "kebl3541"
    repo:   "kebl3541/Obsidian-Umbra"
    slug:   "umbra"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/umbra"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/kebl3541/Obsidian-Umbra"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kebl3541/Obsidian-Umbra/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "A very dark, near‑black interface with hairline borders and muted grays to let your notes recede into the foreground. Choose a single desaturated violet accent (default) or set your own via Style Settings to colour links, tags, caret and subtle highlights; headings vary by weight, not colour. Fade completed tasks and strip heavy chrome and shadows, keeping popovers for depth."
}
```
